desired.headline: AI Systems Engineer | Building Voice AI, RAG & Full-Stack Enterprise Products | Security Analyst at Virtual Galaxy Infotech
desired.about:
I build AI systems that move beyond demos into real operational use. At Virtual Galaxy Infotech, I work across applied AI, product engineering and security, taking ownership from architecture and data pipelines through deployment and user-facing workflows.

As lead developer for Vaani, I built a multilingual voice-agent platform supporting seven Indian languages, mid-call language switching, real inbound and outbound SIP calls, and a dashboard that lets tenants configure and operate their own agents. I also led a citation-first RAG proof of concept for Konkan Railway across approximately 6,500 pages of operating and engineering manuals, and delivered systems for Sir J.J. Hospital covering radiology asset management and MRI appointment workflows.

Earlier, I built a legal drafting system over 5,000+ judgments, developed Windows and Linux DLP agents, and worked on MLOps and data products at PreProd Corp. I enjoy solving ambiguous operational problems with reliable AI, thoughtful interfaces and infrastructure I can understand end to end.

Current interests: production RAG, voice AI, agentic workflows, full-stack AI products, security engineering and self-hosted systems.

Portfolio: https://vanshraja.me
